rationale: Price is at 94.8% of today's range and within 0.19% of the session high after a strong intraday rally, with the broader market down 1.35% and volatility elevated (VIXY +6.25%), creating a divergent and extended setup with poor risk/reward in either direction. A long entry near the high with only 31 minutes to close risks a mean-reversion snap against a weak tape, while a short against strong momentum with no news catalyst and elevated relative volume (3.28x) is equally dangerous. The spread is wide enough and the remaining time short enough that the expected value of any new position is insufficient to justify the risk.
